summary: Implement JavaScript string iteration used by for...of and spread.

target.notes: Yield substrings representing UTF-16 encoded code points: valid surrogate pairs are yielded together, unpaired surrogates are yielded as one-code-unit strings. This is not grapheme iteration.

semantics.iteration_unit: Unicode code point encoded as one or two UTF-16 code units
semantics.unpaired_surrogate: yielded unchanged as one string element

caveats: .NET char enumeration is code-unit based; Rune enumeration may replace invalid surrogate data, so neither is automatically exact.

tests.name: astral pair is one iteration item
zwj sequence is multiple items
tests.expected_behavior: iterates code points, not one grapheme cluster
